acceptance: Unchanged independent deterministic 2x200 ground episodes; no expert prefix or BC assistance at evaluation.
identity: automatic teacher search + real-history dataset + BC initialization + PPO; never label this pure PPO
implementation_status: DESIGN_ONLY: dataset writer/BC/training-prefix executor not yet implemented; do not invent an executable training CLI. Native diagnostic is prepared separately.
reward_version: qualified-recovery-draft-v1 (shadow-only implementation; integration requires authorization and equivalence tests)

data.source: Only stored bounded 8-parameter capability trajectories and new explicitly budgeted local search around them; current unique success is a seed, not a robust teacher.
data.split: Split whole episodes and parameter families before collection; no adjacent-frame splitting. Never select teachers using dev_jump_v2_a/b or G10.
fields: bounded applied teacher action and original command
data.selection: Full successful episodes may supply recovery targets; failed episodes with a qualified flight supply only the prefix before unsafe landing/body contact. Never label post-fall actions as recovery targets. Cap standing/settling-only examples at 10% of BC batches; report class/phase counts.
data.BC_targets: Applied bounded actions, not out-of-bounds Gaussian samples; normalize using training split only, freeze at validation.

curriculum.BC: Bounded action regression initializes actor/compatible normalization; value/optimizer reset explicitly. Offline error is not success.
curriculum.PPO: If recovery needs a prefix, execute the expert prefix physically from ground. Collect policy-gradient transitions only after policy takeover; do not silently score teacher actions as on-policy samples. Prefix computation and failed prefixes count in budget. Implement and CPU-test the transition boundary/history/timeout handling before any training.
curriculum.advance_condition: At least 128 independent training-validation episodes; qualified-landing fraction >=0.8 and complete recovery conditional on qualified landing >=0.5. These are curriculum gates, not lowered G04 acceptance. Otherwise stop and retain the failed stage.
curriculum.last_stage: Policy controls the entire episode from t=0. Evaluation never uses a teacher prefix or state teleport.

stopping_rules: Stop teacher search at its fixed cap if fewer than 16 full-success episodes across at least 4 parameter families and 2 collection batches are found; do not build a recovery teacher from one success.
Stop before PPO if held-out BC closed-loop validation performs worse than the same teacher parameter families by >20 percentage points in qualified-flight rate, or body contact exceeds 50%.
Stop a curriculum stage at 25 updates without its gate; do not autonomously design another reward or widen hardware limits.
Immediate stop for numerical/contract/budget failure. Physical interaction cap overrides target update count, including frequent prefix resets.
next_authorized_action: Approve this distinct research branch and its per-phase caps, then implement/review dataset, BC and prefix rollout boundaries before launching training. No guided GPU training command exists yet.
